craft_notes: Sthāyin: cakrodaya unit 9. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 7. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: By twenty-four hundreds but in nine-syllable rising would be; by sixty-one-twenty of hundreds in ten-syllable.
